extracted.intended_audience: PD/PI applicants to the NIGMS MIRA (R35) program preparing the Current & Pending Support attachment
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and required content/format for the PD/PI Current & Pending Support attachment submitted with a MIRA (R35) application. Specifies what projects to list, financial fields to report, ordering, and overlap disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment required for MIRA application (PD/PI only)
rubrics_metrics.description: This attachment is required. For the PD/PI only, use the SF424 R&R Current and Pending Support instructions as modified here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This Current & Pending Support information is not requested for most NIH grant applications but is required for a MIRA application and will be considered by reviewers. It is different from the Just-in-Time Other Support information. You do not need to use the SF424 Format page for this attachment, but must follow the FOA instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: List scope of projects: ongoing, completed (past 3 years), and pending
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing and completed research projects from the past three years as well as pending application(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both active and recently completed projects (within past 3 years) and any pending applications. Distinguish clearly between Current Support and Pending sections (see examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Briefly state overall goals and PI responsibilities for each project
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly indicate the overall goals of the projects and your responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed project provide a short description of project aims and explicitly state the PD/PI's role and responsibilities (e.g., lead, subproject PI, contributor). Example entries show concise project titles and 1–2 sentence descriptions of aims and approaches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explain any overlap with other awards or pending applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain if there is any overlap with other awards and pending applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For overlapping funding/pending applications describe the nature and extent of overlap (e.g., 'overlaps completely and will replace the 2 NIGMS R01s and the PI’s subaward on the RM1'). Reviewers will consider overlap when evaluating the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report Total Costs for the Entire Project Period (include indirect costs)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Total Costs for the Entire Project Period (including Indirect Costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Costs should reflect the full award period and include indirect costs where applicable. Example: "$1,500,000 Total Costs for Entire Project Period (including Indirect Costs)".

rubrics_metrics.name: Report Annual Direct Costs allocated to MIRA PI's laboratory
rubrics_metrics.description: List Annual Direct Costs allocated to the MIRA PD's/PI's laboratory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the annual direct costs that will be spent in the MIRA PI’s laboratory (separate from total award amount). Example: "$250,000/yr Annual Direct Costs" and indicate if that includes subcontract indirect costs or subaward amounts that go to collaborators' labs.

rubrics_metrics.name: List subawards/subcontracts to collaborator laboratories (with amounts and Subcontract PI)
rubrics_metrics.description: List subawards to collaborator(s)' laboratories, including amounts and Subcontract PI where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When part of an award is a subcontract, indicate the subcontract amount and name the Subcontract PI (e.g., "Includes $50,000 annual total cost subcontract to Other University (Subcontract PI: Jane Doe)"). Include whether subcontract indirect costs are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: State PD/PI effort on each grant in person-months (cal mos)
rubrics_metrics.description: List the PD's/PI's effort on each grant in person-months (calendar months).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report effort as calendar months (e.g., "1.6 cal mos"). Include effort even for subprojects or roles on multi-PI awards so reviewers can assess commitment and potential overlap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report all sources of support including foreign support
rubrics_metrics.description: All sources of support including foreign support should be reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not omit foreign or non-U.S. sources. The instruction explicitly requires reporting all support sources; list NIGMS grants first, then other NIH, then other sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prescribed ordering of listed support
rubrics_metrics.description: List NIGMS grants first, followed by other NIH grants, followed by other sources of support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow this ordering when composing the attachment so that NIGMS support is presented before other NIH and non-NIH sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the general format and required fields for each entry
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the specified general format fields: Funding Source; Grant Number (PI: NAME); Award Period; Total Costs for Entire Award Period; Annual Direct Costs to MIRA Applicant PI’s Laboratory; PI, and Consortium/Subproject/Subcontract Information; 'Title of Project'; Description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arrange each project entry to include each of these fields. Example entries in the FOA show exact placement and wording (e.g., Funding Source: National Institute of General Medical Sciences; Grant Number: R01 GMxxxxxx-xx (PI: your name); Award Period: 08/01/18-07/31/22; etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate role if not the MIRA PD/PI
rubrics_metrics.description: If the PD/PI is not the award PI, indicate the role (e.g., Subproject PI, Consortium member).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a clear label such as 'Subproject 2 (PI: your name)' or include a 'Role if not' field to make responsibilities and responsibilities explicit to reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate and label Current Support vs Pending sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Distinguish current (active/completed) support from pending applications and label them accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide separate sections headed 'Current Support' and 'Pending' (or similar). For pending applications include requested amounts and requested annual direct costs and indicate any overlap with existing awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow FOA modifications to SF424 R&R instructions (do not use SF424 page)
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the instructions in the FOA which modify the SF424 R&R Current and Pending Support instructions. You do not need to use the SF424 Format page for this attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FOA-specific modifications rather than the generic SF424 page; the FOA text supersedes the standard form for this attachment.
